title: Multi Group Scouting EA with Grid Hedge fallback after 10-order martingale + ATR trailing
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 (oversold) + doji with long lower wick (lower wick > upper wick, upper wick > body)
entry_short: RSI(7)>70 (overbought) + doji with long upper wick (upper wick > lower wick, lower wick > body)
exit: no SL/TP; close basket at +$3 profit; ATR-scaled trailing stop (ATR*TSmultiplier*2) once 2+ orders open
escalation_cap: 10 martingale adds then switches to opposite-direction hedge grid (0.05 lot fixed) capped by user-tuned Max_Order_close_All
buildon_idea: already has a cap concept (10-order martingale limit + hedge fallback); formalize as hard position cap and test flat-lot (no escalation) to isolate entry edge from martingale effect; ATR-trailing exit is reusable as a standalone module
novelty_note: grid-hedge fallback (open opposite-direction basket after martingale limit hit) is a distinctive martingale-rescue mechanism, worth cataloging separately from plain martingale

title: Zone Trading strategy: 3-candle reversal zone lines + escalating martingale loss steps
entry_long: 3-candle pattern: candles ID3+ID2 bearish, ID1 bullish reversal closing above ID2 open -> draw support line; price dips back down and crosses up through that line -> buy
entry_short: 3-candle pattern: candles ID3+ID2 bullish, ID1 bearish reversal closing below ID2 open -> draw resistance line; price rallies back up and crosses down through that line -> sell
exit: fixed SL 20 pips / TP 40 pips per order; optional break-even (breakeven point 20 pips, offset 5 pips); basket loss-step framework doubles lot+loss-target every escalation, resets on profit above starting balance
escalation_cap: none stated (lot doubles and loss-step doubles every time cumulative loss exceeds current step threshold, starting -$15, no explicit max steps)
buildon_idea: add explicit max-step cap and a hard cut-loss (only informally mentioned, e.g. -$3000); flat-lot test first to isolate whether the zone-reversal entry has edge without the martingale escalation
novelty_note: zone-drawing from 3-candle reversal pattern is a reusable support/resistance detection idea distinct from indicator-based S/R

title: EMA200 trend filter + engulfing pattern with escalating martingale loss-step doubling
entry_long: 3-candle pattern (ID3 bearish, ID2 bearish, ID1 bullish engulfing closing above ID2 open) with ID1 close above EMA200
entry_short: 3-candle pattern (ID3 bullish, ID2 bullish, ID1 bearish engulfing closing below ID2 open) with ID1 close below EMA200
exit: fixed SL 300 pips / TP 500 pips; close basket at $30 profit if in follow-trend mode (win), $5 if in reverse-trend/martingale mode (loss recovery)
escalation_cap: none stated (lot_x=2 doubling triggered whenever cumulative loss exceeds current loss-step threshold, starting -$15 -> -30 -> -60 -> -120 -> -240..., narrator suggests optionally capping total loss around -$3000 but does not implement it as a hard rule)
buildon_idea: implement the narrator's own suggested -$3000 hard cut-loss + terminate-EA-on-breach as an actual rule (currently only mentioned verbally); flat-lot test to check if EMA200+engulfing entry has edge without escalation
novelty_note: per-order fixed SL/TP combined with a separate martingale escalation ladder is a distinct risk layering vs the SL-less grid-martingale variants in this batch

title: Multi Group Scouting EA using EMA-High/EMA-Low envelope + dual-timeframe RSI + doji, stepped grid-add
entry_long: RSI(1hr,14)<30 AND RSI(5min,7)<30, candle ID1 is doji with long lower wick, candle low below EMA-Low AND candle high below EMA-High, and candle range (high-low) > 100 pips
entry_short: RSI(1hr,14)>70 AND RSI(5min,7)>70, candle ID1 is doji with long upper wick, candle high above EMA-High AND candle low above EMA-Low, and candle range > 100 pips
exit: no SL/TP; grid-add every 60 pips; close basket at $30 profit; trailing stop 60 pips (step 1) once 2 orders open
escalation_cap: lot +0.01 every 5 grid-add steps (no stated max order count / no cut-loss in this transcript)
buildon_idea: add explicit Max_Order cap and a cut-loss (missing here, unlike sibling EX171 qoII84ixew4 which has both); EMA-High/EMA-Low envelope + dual-TF RSI oversold/overbought confirmation is a reusable confirmation-stacking pattern worth extracting standalone
novelty_note: EMA-of-High and EMA-of-Low as an envelope (instead of standard EMA of close) to confirm doji significance is a distinctive, less-common technique

title: Gold Robot EA: EMA-High/EMA-Low envelope + RSI + doji with manual buy/sell buttons, time filter, cut-loss and Max_Order cap
entry_long: time filter 14:00-22:00 server; manual mode-buy toggle=true; RSI oversold; doji with long lower wick; candle low below EMA-Low AND candle high below EMA-High; candle range >100 pips; spread filter <30
entry_short: same but RSI overbought + doji long upper wick + candle high above EMA-High AND candle low above EMA-Low; spread filter <30
exit: no SL/TP per order; ATR-scaled trailing stop (ATR*TS*2) once 2+ orders open; basket close scales with number of open orders (variable close-money formula, min $5); hard cut-loss -$3000 fixed, terminates EA
escalation_cap: lot +0.01 every 5 grid-add steps, capped at Max_Order=50 orders per side, plus -$3000 equity cut-loss (EA terminates, must be restarted manually)
buildon_idea: has a real cap+cut-loss already (build-on candidate); test flat-lot (disable grid-add escalation) to isolate whether the EMA-envelope+RSI+doji entry has standalone edge; the on-chart manual buy/sell button + edit-field lot-size pattern is reusable UI scaffolding for semi-auto EAs
novelty_note: manual override buttons sharing the EA's magic number (so manual clicks get swept into the same basket-close logic) is a distinctive semi-auto design worth cataloging

title: Double RSI dual-timeframe + doji entry with switching-mode profit target (follow-trend vs reverse-trend)
entry_long: RSI(1hr)<30 AND RSI(current TF)<30, doji with long lower wick (lower wick/2 still > upper wick, upper wick > body)
entry_short: RSI(1hr)>70 AND RSI(current TF)>70, doji with long upper wick (mirror condition)
exit: no SL/TP; grid-add every 100 pips; close basket at $30 if in follow-trend mode, $5 if in reverse-trend/martingale-recovery mode; hard cut-loss -$3000, terminates EA
escalation_cap: lot +0.01 every 5 grid-add steps in reverse-trend mode; overall risk bounded by -$3000 equity cut-loss (no explicit max-order count stated in this transcript)
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-order count cap alongside the existing cut-loss; the 'switching mode' idea (a basket can flip between follow-trend and reverse-trend profit targets depending on which direction price broke first) is a reusable exit-state-machine pattern distinct from the fixed hedge/martingale split seen elsewhere in this batch
novelty_note: switching-mode (single basket toggles between FT/RT profit targets rather than spawning a separate hedge basket) is the key novel idea this video credits to a course member; author reports 34% return/6.9% DD in back-test (2024) vs a plain multi-group-scouting baseline's lower return, though this is presented as-is, not independently verified

title: Multi Group Scouting EA / Switching Mode with RSI2-TF+doji entry, Max_Order cap, and cut-loss
indicators: RSI7 (1hr, current TF via input toggle)
entry_long: manual buy-mode toggle=true, no existing buy position group1, RSI(1hr)<30 AND RSI(current TF)<30, doji with long lower wick
entry_short: manual sell-mode toggle=true, no existing sell position group2, RSI(1hr)>70 AND RSI(current TF)>70, doji with long upper wick
exit: no SL/TP; grid-add every 100 pips; close basket at $30 (follow-trend/win state) or $5 (reverse-trend/martingale-recovery state); hard cut-loss -$3000 equity, terminates EA
escalation_cap: lot +0.01 every 5 grid-add steps, capped at Max_Order_close_all=50, plus -$3000 equity cut-loss (terminates EA)
buildon_idea: already has both position cap and cut-loss (build-on candidate); flat-lot test to check if RSI-dual-TF+doji entry alone has edge; author reports 2024 back-test 2290 orders / +34.33% return / 7.8% relative DD (self-reported, not independently verified) — good candidate for the shortlist given cap+cut-loss are already implemented
novelty_note: same switching-mode concept as sibling eBaRWynVj-g but with the position cap + cut-loss actually implemented, making this the more build-on-ready of the pair

title: Scalping EA: Bollinger Band breakout-then-pullback support/resistance lines, linear-add grid, capped at 30 orders + 30% cut-loss
entry_long: price closes below lower band on a >=100-pip bearish candle -> draw support line at that close; if price crosses back above that support line within 30 candles -> buy
entry_short: price closes above upper band on a >=100-pip bullish candle -> draw resistance line at that close; if price crosses back below that resistance line within 30 candles -> sell
exit: no SL/TP; grid-add every 100 pips with lot increasing by +0.01 every add (uncapped per-step, capped by Max_Order); close basket at $30 profit in martingale/reverse mode; trailing stop 200/step2 in follow-trend mode; cut-loss = 30% of balance
escalation_cap: Max_Order=30 orders per side; cut-loss at 30% of account balance
buildon_idea: already capped (30 orders + 30% equity cut-loss) — build-on candidate; test flat-lot (disable the +0.01/add increase) to isolate whether the breakout-then-pullback S/R signal has edge alone; author reports 2024 XAUUSD back-test 5928 orders / >200% return with high DD when tuned aggressively, or 5-year pass with lower DD (<30%) when tuned conservatively (self-reported)
novelty_note: drawing dynamic S/R lines from Bollinger-Band breakout candles (rather than fixed pivot/swing points), then trading the pullback-reclaim of that same line, is a distinctive line-based signal generation approach

title: Bollinger Band breakout/pullback S/R lines with 10-candle reset window, per-order linear-add lot, -$3000 cut-loss
entry_long: price closes below lower band on a >=100-pip bearish candle -> draw support line; bearish break flagged; if price crosses back above that support line within 10 candles -> buy (else support line is redrawn after 10 candles)
entry_short: price closes above upper band on a >=100-pip bullish candle -> draw resistance line; bullish break flagged; if price crosses back below that resistance line within 10 candles -> sell (else resistance line is redrawn after 10 candles)
exit: no SL/TP; grid-add every 100 pips with lot increasing +0.01 every add (uncapped step count in this transcript); close basket at $5 profit; hard cut-loss -$3000, terminates EA on breach
escalation_cap: no explicit max-order count stated (relies on -$3000 equity cut-loss as the only hard stop)
buildon_idea: add an explicit Max_Order position-count cap (sibling video 2113NNp3rk0 uses the same concept with Max_Order=30 — port that cap here); flat-lot test to isolate whether the breakout-then-pullback signal has edge without the per-order lot increase
novelty_note: same breakout-then-pullback S/R line concept as sibling 2113NNp3rk0 but with a shorter 10-candle reset window and $5 quick-close instead of $30/trailing-stop follow-trend logic — a more scalp-oriented parameterization of the same idea
